description: A slender pointed hand tool used to separate and tease apart the twisted strands of a cord so its fibres can be spread flat. It is pushed between strands and then through each strand to straighten the threads.
name: binder's bodkin

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VIII, p.115. Internet Archive.
